title: Day 1 vs day 58 building my casino resort.
author: TheGrowthYardGaming
selftext:
A lot has improved since I first posted this. I listened to feedback of real players and had over 1,000 people try my game since I went live and released multiplayer. Every machine in this image is playable and you don't see the arcade that is full of non casino games.

  
The early access is available for free online if anyone wants to try it. I am working on a lot of upgrades as we speak and truly appreciate all feedback if anyone does try this.

  
[https://play.sunspireresort.com/](https://play.sunspireresort.com/)

comments.author: hawtdawtz
comments.body: “No connection the bank is closed” on the first task and got stuck. looks neat though. For my taste, the font is and style is just a tad too low rez it hurts my eyes. I’ll go as pixel dense as say stardew before it’s just not that appealing for me style wise

replies.author: TheGrowthYardGaming
replies.body:
Thank you for trying it! Where did this happen at? Right when you loaded into game or when you tried to open a machine?



I agree, I am working on changing the font. I sucked at font long before AI...

In about 1-2 hours the character design update will be pushed and I think that will make huge impact. Once I get the structure and gameplay loop nailed down I will really go back and polish everything.

Even using Ai this has consumed 10+ hours of my life for the past month.

replies.author: hawtdawtz
replies.body: I have a successful mobile app build mostly by AI, been working on it several hours a day on the side for \~5 months now. It’s a journey. Marketing is the hard part. Need a semi polished product to deliver first

comments.author: couldgiveaflyingfck
comments.body: Well, this game seems like a hoot! I'm imagining couples or groups starting with a set budget, then gambling their way through, winning big or losing it all. It's got a certain thrill to it, I'll give it that.
